digit_order_dispositions.source: How many bars of E7 open the 12-bar blues?
digit_order_dispositions.target: บลูส์ 12 ห้องเริ่มด้วย E7 กี่ห้อง

digit_order_dispositions.reason: Thai explicitly places finger 1 pressing fret 5 before picking, then finger 3 hammering onto fret 7, all on string 3. Reordering finger/fret phrases correctly disambiguates the physical instruction without changing any numeric referent.
